sourceStatus: retained generated four-view draft; not owner-approved turnaround geometry
preparation: Use all visible pixels of the full mech in each named quadrant. No chest isolation or silhouette editing.
Tightly crop the alpha mask at threshold 128, matching the article's occupied-pixel threshold.
Apply the same nominal nearest-neighbor scale factor to every view, chosen to make the side view 32 pixels high. Round each resulting dimension to the nearest whole pixel.
Keep the source RGB values. No custom palette, geometric fitting, waist alignment or color projection is applied during input preparation.
limitations: The side drawing's arm occludes part of the lower chest. A crop of its visible chest would not establish the full isolated chest silhouette.
Back-view lateral chest surfaces and shoulder mounts do not have an unambiguous isolated-component boundary.
The generated views differ slightly in measured width and depth. The article converter's own fitting stage handles dimensions; that fitting does not prove semantic consistency or hidden geometry.
